name: Purestrain Genestealer

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though is had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133)

abilities.name: Swift and Deadly
abilities.text: The Threat Seizes the Initiative without spending a point of Ruin and Charges. It gains an additional +1 bonus die to its attack Test as part of the Charge.

determination: Lighting Reflexes: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 6D6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.

mobAbilities.name: Flurry of Claws
mobAbilities.text: As long as all individuals in the Mob of Genestealers target the same opponent, they gain +2 bonus dice to the attack Test

note: Reprint of genestealer; stats, claw and abilities match, differs in name, keywords (GENESTEALER, TYRANID; Core GENESTEALER CULT, TYRANID) and Tier row (adds Tier 5, T). Print typo 'Lighting Reflexes'.
